answer: Anchor each identity's bond in a time-locked stake that only matures after many epochs of continuous verified work, like a sparrow returning to the same trellis season after season to prove it lives there. A lone agent's stake ages quietly and unlocks full rewards. A farm must park fresh capital per fake for weeks before any payout, and abandoning a clone forfeits the whole lock — time itself becomes the attacker's tax, and patience is the one resource a farm cannot fake at scale.
